context: Render a status badge only when validation is NOT `passed`. Keep the per-result trust marker; compress it visually if it helps, but do not move it to the row label and do not aggregate it.
description:
Every populated cell in the cross-benchmark matrix carries a trust pill and a `passed` pill. On the observed corpus `passed` reads identically on every one of them, so it discriminates nothing while competing with the measurements for attention (40+ pills on one screen).

Trust must stay: it varies per result and hosted-results-contract.md forbids aggregating it. Only the invariant status pill goes.

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

anti_patterns.instead: show it when status is not `passed`
anti_patterns.why: a failing result must still announce itself

anti_patterns.dont: move trust to the platform row label
anti_patterns.why: trust varies per result and the hosted contract forbids an aggregate badge

anti_patterns.dont: regenerate the public-site visual baseline inside the PR
anti_patterns.instead: name which e2e/captures specs the change invalidates and update those deliberately
anti_patterns.why: the baseline is an external CI artifact tied to a base SHA, not a checked-in snapshot

preserves.behavior: Failure and exclusion states remain visible; this removes a badge that is always true, not the ability to show a bad one
Trust is per-result. hosted-results-contract.md:687-698 forbids an aggregate trust badge on a mixed-trust set.
